proposals.competing_hypothesis: If BPR_MF ranking quality is limited by uncontrolled embedding magnitude rather than by popularity-biased score geometry, then adding a soft norm constraint should improve or stabilize NDCG@10 more cleanly than popularity-sensitive regularization.
proposals.failure_mode: The soft norm constraint may over-compress user/item embeddings, reducing score separation and hurting top-rank discrimination if baseline capacity was already well-calibrated.
proposals.mechanism_hypothesis: Applying a soft embedding norm constraint to BPR_MF changes only representation geometry, testing whether tighter control of latent vector scale improves generalization under full-sort evaluation without altering the pairwise objective itself.
proposals.predicted_outcome_signature: Relative to BPR_MF, expect modest but consistent movement in NDCG@10 with reduced variance across runs; gains should appear as cleaner top-10 ordering rather than popularity-skewed shifts in item exposure.
